notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.6.2 - Hotfix
notes.content: This patch addresses an issue where memory cards loaded in power stations would disappear if the player left the facility without retrieving the card and returned later. With this update, memory cards will persist in power stations, ensuring they remain available for retrieval.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.5 - Regular Update
notes.content:
Dear Damned Divers,

We are excited to announce that we can finally release patch 1.2.5 for Hell Dive!

This new patch is packed with improvements, bug fixes, and extra goodies. Here are the most relevant additions:

 Achievements - You asked, and we listened! The game now features 35 achievements to unlock, and some will be quite tricky. You’ll need to explore every corner of this cursed ocean to get them all!
 A New Ending - We heard your feedback that the original ending was underwhelming, so we went back to the workshop to build, test and sleep way too little. We think you're going to like what we've created!!
 New Notes - There are new notes to find and more lore to obsess over!
 Clear Reading - We've made it easier for players to read on-screen text, regardless of visual or cognitive impairments. 
 Audio Improvements - The audio mixing was inconsistent before, but we've streamlined it to eliminate unwanted sounds and hisses! All in the spirit of building proper fear for you all. You're welcome! :)
 New Save/Load system - Saving and loading where beasts to tackle. Every new feature or tiny tweak to make our dive deeper, darker, and better had us bracing for crashes and development chaos. Fixing it was the only way forward.
 Performance Improvements - We spent a lot of time revamping the game's way of loading data and achieved performance improvements of up to 440%!


Important Note: Due to the complete rebuild of the Save/Load system, previous save files are sadly no longer compatible. Additionally, the previous achievements have been removed as they are no longer achievable.

We apologize for any inconvenience! We hope that the improvements and new content will make up for it.

Thank you for the support!
- The Teacup Games Team

notes.title: Sixth Development Log: You Hellish People
notes.content:
Dear Damned Divers!

Welcome to the Sixth development log for Hell Dive! This one took some time to arrive.

You are Making This Hell Fun
Watching all of you play Hell Dive has been surreal. From the life-sucking, game-breaking bugs at launch in January to the disappointment some felt with our original Hell ending! That really freaked us out. We had been testing with players and doing soul-wrenching QA pretty much 24/7. And then we hit the market. CRASH and BURN!

But now May is arriving. And we are having a game that brings screams, laughter, and small moments of pure chaos. Moments like falling through walls from shaking too hard. Or calmly sneaking after one of our monsters... just to stare at its very well-shaped booty. Or watching those horrific food videos that can never be unseen. (We’re not naming names, but you know who you are, Mister!) Or having this “big gaming” guy casually say, “just hanging in there,” at the most perfect time. Or... There are so many great moment. 

We love them all. Every slow-burning, chaotic second.

Your reactions and feedback, the good and the ugly, and your mix of joy and terror mean the world to us. Our director is addicted to watching your streams, constantly studying how you play to make Hell Dive even better, one terrifying little nudge at a time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310266/88aa0809c72eb8685f2cd4dae935dcfc5f193b9a.jpg

From the whole tiny  teacup team: THANK YOU.
You motivate us to keep pushing and to keep growing.

More Darkness, Achievements, and the Hellish End!
It’s time to reveal the hellish ending we’ve been working so hard on! Along with this, we’ve added more achievements, fixed the “blinded by the divine light” bug, and implemented tons of optimizations. There’s still so much more we want to do, but we’re really excited to see how all the new changes are being received! :)

Thank You for Diving In
We appreciate your support and can’t wait for you to experience what’s coming next.

The Teacup Games Team

notes.title: Fourth Development Log: A New Ending
notes.content:
Dear Damned Divers!

Welcome to out Fourth development log for Hell Dive, where we share our journey and the latest updates with you! 

A Horrible Ending 
Seeing all you amazing people enjoying Hell Dive meant a lot to me personally. I loved it!
BUT the sheer disappointment with the ending and the empty promises of a deeper lore, really frustrated me and the team. We heard you! In the end, I failed to deliver the unsettling horror experience I set out to create, and that is unacceptable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310266/711e214f939dfccbee9f2e8776e46e068be8e739.jpg

This is being corrected as we speak. Over the past week, I’ve been writing, biting my nails, drawing, pacing, pulling my hair, grinding my teeth, and drinking endless cups of tea. But it was worth it. Now, we have the foundation for an ending that I believe fits the game.

There will also be some new small scares to enjoy, added to build up for the new ending.

Thank You for Diving In

Thomas-Bo and rest of The Teacup Games Team

notes.title: Third Development Log
notes.content:
Dear Damned Divers!

Welcome to the third official development log for Hell Dive, where we share our journey and the latest updates with you! 

Meet the Decoy
Say hello to the Decoy, a monstrous creature known for its creepy moonwalks and its lethal hugs of death. This nasty bug terrifying, and we're working hard to make it even creepier for your descent into Hell. But the real question remains: What exactly is the Decoy, and is it Friendly or Deadly?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310266/4ea0f33660c6b2ed8e6d969cc5ba79f26f66f91d.jpg

The Battle Against the Giant Bug
Just as we were preparing to release a new patch, we were ambushed by a giant bug of our own! One that nearly devoured us whole. Its know as the dreaded Memory Leak, this beast wreaked havoc on countless Hell Dive sessions and kept us up at nights. Rarely have we been so pale as we battled to conquer this monstrous foe.

But rest assured, we’ve emerged victorious! The bug has been squashed, and a new patch will be rolling out later today.

Thank You for Diving In
It’s incredible to see more and more of you Damned Divers joining us every day.

- The Teacup Games Team

notes.title: Release date: January 7th
notes.content:
Dear Damned Divers!

As you may know, Hell Dive was originally set to release on Steam tomorrow, December 20th, 2024. However, the good folks at Steam pointed out that this date falls right in the beginning of the Winter Sale, where we would risk getting lost in a sea of incredible offers.

Rather than diving headfirst into the horrors of being overlooked in 2024, we’ve decided to celebrate the new year by making Hell Dive one of the hidden gems of 2025 instead.

We’re happy to announce that Hell Dive will now be launching on January 7th, 2025!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310266/8d75aeac2e351ae6e3004d831281ee0b872bf99f.jpg
Behind the scenes pictures with Fanny and Erika during our sound recording session for Virgil, the A.I. that will guide you in Hell Dive. The icy depths have never sounded this good. 🎙️

Now, it is soon time for you, Damned Divers, to descend.
- The Teacup Games Team

notes.title: First Development Log: Welcome to Hell Dive!
notes.content:
Dear Damned Divers!

Welcome to the first official development log for Hell Dive! The place where we share our journey with you.

For those new to Hell Dive, it’s a first-person horror game set in the eerie depths of COLONY 1265, an abandoned deep-sea mining and research facility. You’ll step into the role of a Maritime Operative navigating between facilities in a submarine, uncovering the colony’s haunting secrets, and surviving the horrors lurking in the abyss.

This game is built with our sweat and blood - because we believe that’s what a game truly deserves.
Wishlist Hell Dive now to stay updated Let us know in the comments what excites you the most about horror games..

We're looking forward to having you Damned Divers with us on this terrifying journey!

- The Teacup Games Team
